name: @glyphh-ai/cli
description: Glyphh — the full-screen agent TUI. The desktop coding agent, in your terminal.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && rm -rf dist && esbuild src/main.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --jsx=automatic --outfile=dist/main.js --sourcemap --external:ink --external:ink-spinner --external:react
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
